.regionSetTheme

Source: R/plotUtils.R
dot-regionSetTheme.Rd

Theme shared by the plotting functions of the package. It follows the look of a publication panel: white background, no grid, black axis lines, no box around the facet labels. Titles and axis titles are rendered as markdown, so that subscripts such as log<sub>2</sub> come out formatted.

Usage

.regionSetTheme(legendPosition = "right", baseSize = 12)

Arguments

legendPosition

String with the position of the legend, one among "right", "left", "top", "bottom" or "none". Default: "right".

baseSize

Numeric value with the base font size. Default: 12.

Value

A ggplot2 theme.

Sebastian Gregoricchio
